commit_message: Complete ADR 0122 spatial audio authoring core
pr_title: Continue ADR 0122 spatial audio ECS synchronization
pr_body:
<!-- gameengine-chatgpt-dispatcher -->

Continues ADR 0122 from the latest-main baseline. Adds current-format spatial authoring fields (rolloff, loop, listener priority), priority-based deterministic listener selection, managed looping/rolloff composition, shared listener diagnostics, Transform dependency validation, and canonical scene fixture coverage.

Project Rust spatial requests and the remaining Editor authoring/preview UX will follow on fresh request IDs before ADR 0122 is marked Accepted.
